name: Cybertechnologist Scholar Archetype
body:
Associated Skill Craft (mechanical) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Skillslot (Ex)

You gain a skill slot cybernetic implant and one mark I skill chip of your choice. You do not need to pay for these items. This implant does not take up your brain slot, nor does it count toward your implantation value limit.

Associated Technique
Predictive Technique (Ex)

Thanks to special predictive algorithms in your skillslot cybernetic implant, you are better at anticipating danger. You gain a +1 bonus to Reflex saving throws against all spells and attacks made by a target you have studied with this ability. At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +6 at 20th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Bio-Technomancy (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): Intelligence 13, Skillslot study ability, scholar level 3rd.

Once per day, when you have a skill chip inserted into a skillslot, you can activate a spell-like ability. This expends 1 point of inspiration. Your caster level for this spell-like ability is equal to your number of ranks in the skill listed (minimum 1), and the DC (if applicable) is equal to 10 + the tier of the skill chip + the ability score modifier you use for that skill. (Also use that ability score modifier if making a concentration check or caster level check.) You can use this ability (with the same skill chip or a different skill chip) one additional time per day when you reach 7 ranks, 13 ranks, and 19 ranks in Craft (mechanical). If you remove your skill chip before a spell’s duration would normally end, it ends immediately.

Bionic Upgrade (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Skillslot study ability, scholar level 5th.

You gain your choice of mark I cyberfiber muscles, a mark I thoracic nanite chamber, or mark I wirejack tendons.

Your chosen cybernetic implant takes up your body slot, but you don’t need to pay for it nor make a check to implant it. When you reach 10 ranks in Craft (mechanical), your implant automatically upgrades to mark II; when you reach 15 ranks, it automatically upgrades to mark III.

Cybernetics Doctor (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Craft (mechanical) 7 ranks, Skillslot study ability, scholar level 7th.

You gain Craft Cybernetics as a bonus feat. You do not need to meet the usual prerequisites for this feat, and you do not need a proper Cybernetics Lab to craft such items. You can use Craft (mechanical) for any skill checks needed to craft, install, or identify cybernetics.

Dermal Plating (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Skillslot study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain mark I dermal plating. You do not need to pay for this implant nor make a check to implant it, and unlike normal dermal plating, this cybernetic implant does not occupy your body slot (leaving it free for another cybernetic implant if you so choose). When you reach 5 ranks in Craft (mechanical), and every 5 ranks thereafter, your dermal plating automatically upgrades to the next highest tier, to a maximum of mark V at 20 ranks.
